job: Read one guide, top to bottom, with a table of contents and the page before and after.
purpose: A docs article: a head, prose with an agent picker, steps, code, tables and callouts, an On this page column that follows the reader, a helpful vote and previous and next. The article can be loading or fail with Retry; the head stays so the reader knows where they are.
useWhen: A concept or task needs a long page of prose and code.
The reader should see the headings at a glance.

avoidWhen.when: The page documents one endpoint with its parameters.
The page is the way in to the whole docs.

states.name: loading
states.how: ?state=loading: skeleton text, a card and headings; no table of contents
